title: Phone-safe evidence ZIP playback
details: The Evidence Player can now read video and audio directly from the Complete Evidence ZIP on Android, iPhone and desktop instead of relying on the browser being allowed to open neighbouring local files
Reviewers tap Open complete evidence ZIP once and choose the ZIP they received; the player reads the ZIP locally on the device and nothing is uploaded
The video selector, draggable timeline, -10/+10 second controls and PDF timestamp jump all work with media loaded directly from the ZIP
Current Milos evidence packages store video and audio uncompressed inside the ZIP for reliable direct access, while documents remain DEFLATE-compressed
The manual single-video picker remains as a fallback and the existing MP4 fast-start and WebM duration protections are retained
